ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Neptune

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1799446254000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.
